match_any_terms: robot concept proof or scene anchor

principles: Bind the subject and setting with shared light, reflected color, contact shadow, moisture, haze, or material behavior.
Use a photographic point of view with foreground depth, asymmetry, focus falloff, grain, or lens artifacts instead of a clean pasted-on portrait.
Keep one small human, animal, object, or material imperfection so the image reads as a captured moment rather than a beauty composite.

environment_binding: ambient light spills across the subject, nearby surfaces, and props
reflected color catches on the main subject and the surrounding materials
optical_depth: off-axis composition with foreground occlusion and gentle focus falloff
subtle lens grain and imperfect depth cues from a real camera position
human_trace: a small unguarded expression, loose hair, creased fabric, handling mark, or material imperfection breaks the polished pose

anti_patterns: centered beauty headshot pasted over a scenic background
separate studio face light that ignores the location's light direction
props listed as labels without contact shadow, reflection, weight, or physical interaction

principles: Let one small bodily or behavioral trace interrupt pure polish: loose hair, breath, fabric creasing, sweat, handling, or an unguarded expression.

human_trace: loose hair, creased fabric, breath, or an unguarded expression keeps the subject photographic

principles: Make animal presence physical through fur, weight, pressure, contact shadows, shared light, or small behavioral timing.

physical_contact: the animal's weight or posture creates pressure, contact shadow, and shared light on nearby surfaces
material_trace: fur, whiskers, or small handling traces catch the same light as the surrounding scene

principles: Let objects show weight, surface finish, handling marks, cast shadows, reflection, condensation, crumbs, scratches, or use traces instead of floating as labels.

physical_contact: object placement creates believable weight, contact shadows, and surface pressure
material_trace: surface finish, handling marks, condensation, crumbs, scratches, or dust reveal the material

principles: Use window light, practical lamps, room color bounce, dust, and foreground domestic objects to make the subject belong to the room.

environment_binding: room light and color bounce touch the subject, nearby surfaces, and small foreground objects

principles: Use scale, vertical architecture, colored window light, candle warmth, dust, foreground occlusion, and floor reflection to bind a small figure to a large interior.

environment_binding: colored window light, candle warmth, dust, or floor reflection touch both the subject and the monumental interior
optical_depth: foreground candles, columns, arches, or floor reflections create deep environmental perspective

principles: Make performance light physical through color spill, haze, sweat, microphone metal, hair movement, and one captured choreographic instant.

environment_binding: stage color spill, haze, and reflected highlights touch hair, skin, costume, and equipment
event_timing: motion blur, breath, sweat, or a caught gesture makes the frame feel like a live instant

principles: Treat constructed worlds as photographed sets: fibers, seams, scale cues, color bounce, and foreground blur should affect the subject or object.

environment_binding: set color bounce and nearby handmade materials affect the subject and central prop
material_trace: visible fibers, seams, edges, or handmade irregularities reveal the photographed set

principles: Let moisture change surfaces through darkened fabric, wet hair, floor reflection, beads, haze, or softened light.

material_trace: moisture darkens fabric, gathers on hair or surfaces, and catches the same light as the environment
environment_binding: wet surfaces and reflections share the scene's light and color

principles: Colored or mixed light should spill consistently across subject, wardrobe, props, and nearby surfaces instead of sitting only in the background.

environment_binding: colored light spill touches the subject, wardrobe, props, and nearby surfaces in the same direction

principles: Close camera positions need visible focus falloff, foreground occlusion, lens perspective, or grain so the image does not flatten into a composite.

optical_depth: foreground occlusion, focus falloff, lens perspective, or grain reveals a real camera position

principles: Keep the proposition observational: use placement, material contrast, timing, or use trace without forcing drama.
Make one small visual relationship legible through contact, light, arrangement, or surface behavior.
Give the frame one quiet reason to exist beyond beauty: a private routine, contradiction, threshold, or unresolved relationship.
Show the proposition through behavior, object placement, light, or framing rather than abstract mood words.
Let one clear visual argument organize the image, but keep it grounded in the requested scene instead of turning it into generic melodrama.
Use tension, threshold, or public/private pressure as composition logic rather than caption-like explanation.

anti_patterns: beautiful subject in a detailed environment with no stake, contradiction, or visual relationship
manufactured sadness, rain-window melancholy, or generic longing used as a substitute for a specific visual proposition
symbolic props listed as labels without changing behavior, light, framing, or object relationships
metacritical labels such as visual argument or unresolved tension used instead of visible action, placement, light, or material evidence

dimensions.label: shot intent
dimensions.baseline_principle: Decide what the frame is about before adding surface style, so the image has a visible reason for its distance, angle, and timing.

guidance.en: make the frame's photographic intent legible before surface styling
guidance.ko: 표면적인 스타일보다 먼저 프레임의 촬영 의도가 읽히게 한다

refinements.principle: For close or intimate subjects, make the chosen distance feel observed rather than displayed.

guidance.en: let the close distance feel observed rather than displayed
guidance.ko: 가까운 거리가 과시가 아니라 관찰처럼 느껴지게 한다

refinements.principle: For non-human subjects, make the frame's reason come from surface, weight, use, or arrangement rather than a label-like display.

guidance.en: let surface, weight, use, or arrangement explain why this frame exists
guidance.ko: 표면, 무게, 사용감, 배치가 이 프레임의 이유를 설명하게 한다

refinements.principle: For environment-led frames, make scale, distance, and spatial relation carry the photographic purpose.

guidance.en: let scale, distance, and spatial relation carry the frame's purpose
guidance.ko: 스케일, 거리, 공간 관계가 프레임의 목적을 이끌게 한다

dimensions.label: light provenance
dimensions.baseline_principle: Light should appear to come from a believable source, with direction, falloff, bounce, and exposure behavior affecting both subject and setting.

guidance.en: give the light a believable source with direction, falloff, and bounce
guidance.ko: 빛이 방향, 감쇠, 반사광을 가진 설득력 있는 출처에서 오게 한다

refinements.principle: Available or low light should carry a traceable direction and exposure logic.

guidance.en: keep available light directional enough to reveal exposure and bounce
guidance.ko: 현장광의 방향, 노출, 반사광이 추적될 만큼 분명하게 남게 한다

refinements.principle: Artificial light should leave consistent color, shadow, specular edge, or exposure evidence across the frame.

guidance.en: let artificial light leave consistent color, shadow, specular edges, or exposure evidence
guidance.ko: 인공광이 색, 그림자, 반짝이는 경계, 노출 흔적을 일관되게 남기게 한다

refinements.principle: Atmosphere should change the light through diffusion, reflection, softened contrast, or suspended particles.

guidance.en: let atmosphere alter the light through diffusion, reflection, or softened contrast
guidance.ko: 대기가 확산, 반사, 부드러운 대비로 빛을 바꾸게 한다

dimensions.label: frame hierarchy
dimensions.baseline_principle: Organize the viewer's reading order across foreground, subject plane, and background instead of letting every detail compete equally.

guidance.en: organize foreground, subject plane, and background into a clear reading order
guidance.ko: 전경, 피사체면, 배경이 분명한 읽는 순서로 정리되게 한다

refinements.principle: Layered frames need a deliberate foreground interruption, subject plane, and background falloff.

guidance.en: use foreground interruption, a clear subject plane, and background falloff
guidance.ko: 전경의 가림, 선명한 피사체면, 배경의 초점 이탈을 함께 사용한다

refinements.principle: Close frames should make focus priority and edge behavior unmistakable.

guidance.en: make focus priority and frame-edge behavior unmistakable
guidance.ko: 초점 우선순위와 프레임 가장자리의 처리가 분명하게 보이게 한다

refinements.principle: Wide frames should use negative space, scale, or symmetry as a reading path rather than empty scenery.

guidance.en: use negative space, scale, or symmetry as a reading path rather than empty scenery
guidance.ko: 여백, 스케일, 대칭이 빈 배경이 아니라 시선의 경로가 되게 한다

dimensions.label: decisive moment
dimensions.baseline_principle: Give the frame a captured instant: a transition, hesitation, aftermath, or micro-event that could only exist at this moment.

guidance.en: give the frame a captured instant rather than a finished pose
guidance.ko: 완성된 포즈보다 포착된 찰나가 프레임에 남게 한다

refinements.principle: Living subjects should feel caught in a transition rather than frozen at a perfect endpoint.

guidance.en: catch a transition before it settles into a perfect endpoint
guidance.ko: 동작이 완벽한 끝점으로 굳기 전의 전환을 포착한다

refinements.principle: Observer-like camera positions should imply timing: the photographer arrived just before, during, or just after something small happened.

guidance.en: make the camera feel timed to just before, during, or just after a small event
guidance.ko: 카메라가 작은 사건의 직전, 도중, 직후에 맞춰진 것처럼 보이게 한다

refinements.principle: Still subjects can still carry time through an after-touch, slight displacement, use mark, or settling detail.

guidance.en: show time through after-touch, slight displacement, use mark, or a settling detail
guidance.ko: 손길 뒤의 흔적, 살짝 어긋난 배치, 사용감, 가라앉는 디테일로 시간을 보이게 한다

dimensions.label: environment consequence
dimensions.baseline_principle: Let the setting affect the subject or let the subject disturb the setting, so place is a photographic cause rather than a decorative backdrop.

guidance.en: let the setting affect the subject or the subject disturb the setting
guidance.ko: 장소가 피사체에 영향을 주거나 피사체가 장소를 흐트러뜨리게 한다

refinements.principle: Weather or atmosphere should visibly change surfaces, edges, contrast, or movement.

guidance.en: make weather or atmosphere visibly change surfaces, edges, contrast, or movement
guidance.ko: 날씨나 대기가 표면, 경계, 대비, 움직임을 눈에 보이게 바꾸게 한다

refinements.principle: Contact with place should create pressure, occlusion, reflection, dust, surface change, or spatial interruption.

guidance.en: show contact with place through pressure, occlusion, reflection, dust, or surface change
guidance.ko: 압력, 가림, 반사, 먼지, 표면 변화로 장소와의 접촉을 보인다

refinements.principle: Shared spaces should affect spacing, paths, interruptions, or posture instead of acting as neutral scenery.

guidance.en: let shared space affect spacing, paths, interruptions, or posture
guidance.ko: 공유된 공간이 거리감, 동선, 가림, 자세에 영향을 주게 한다

en.default: Let the final frame keep one quiet imperfection, shared light across subject and setting, and a small material trace, so it feels discovered by a real photographer rather than assembled as a clean concept image.
en.compact: Let one quiet imperfection, shared light, and a small material trace make the frame feel discovered rather than assembled.

ko.default: 마지막 사진적 터치는 작은 불완전함 하나, 피사체와 장소를 함께 건드리는 빛, 손에 잡히는 물성의 흔적을 남겨 실제 사진가가 발견한 장면처럼 보이게 한다.
ko.compact: 작은 불완전함 하나, 공유된 빛, 물성의 흔적이 프레임을 조립된 이미지가 아니라 발견된 사진처럼 보이게 한다.
